title: Word order and focus
summary: Put new or contrasted information in the slot before the verb, recognize the background that speech places after it, mark topics with *ise*, `-(y)sA` and *gelince*, echo words with *m* (*kitap mitap*), and add weight with *ta*, *hem de*, *dA mI* and *işte*.
canDo: Answer who, what, when or where by putting the answer right before the verb
Understand spoken sentences with words after the verb, and keep formal writing verb-final
Set one topic against another with ise, -(y)sA or -(y)A gelince
Use m-doubling, common word pairs and emphatic ta, hem de, dA mI and işte
